# SyntaxAI

> AI developer notebook browser extension. Capture code, docs, and screenshots from any tab; SyntaxAI titles, tags, and stacks them into a searchable library.

- Site: https://syntaxai.app
- Chrome: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/syntaxai/fbkbpcidobeacdbhhinjgbdecnnadejm
- Firefox: https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/syntaxai/
- Privacy: https://syntaxai.app/privacy
- Terms: https://syntaxai.app/terms
- Support: hello@syntaxai.app

Open beta is free with full access. Paid plans are not billed yet. Notes are local-first and sync to the signed-in account. AI runs only on content the user explicitly captures.
